purpose: The trailer v3's music: the owner's verdict on v2 (2026-11-19) asked for the slow opening part with the scenes to have music generated in the style of the desert's (the ember family: guitar-led rock with a tune). The calm part and the action part are two renders, joined at the switch on the first shot.
generator: ACE-Step 1.5 (acestep.cpp v0.0.5), local, AMD RX 6900 XT via Vulkan - C:\Users\panrd\AI\generate-music.ps1 -NoCotCaption, no loop cut

intro.caption: Slow, calm and spacious cinematic desert instrumental with a clear melody: a clean, reverb-drenched twangy electric guitar plays a lonely, beautiful melody over soft airy pads and a deep warm bass drone, no drums at all, no percussion, gentle and atmospheric like a sunrise over the dunes, swelling a little in its last seconds with a tremolo guitar. Wide stereo mix, spacious reverb, modern polished production, no vocals
intro.negative: vocals, singing, voice, choir, drums, percussion, drum beat, snare, hi-hat, audience applause, crowd noise, live recording, childish, cute, toy piano, music box, boomy sub bass, harsh noise, distorted guitar, electronic dance beat, fade out
intro.lyrics: [Intro - clean guitar melody] [Verse - clean guitar melody] [Outro - tremolo swell], each [Instrumental]
intro.chosen: Of three renders (041-043), the calmest by measurement: RMS -21.1 dBFS in its first 25 s (041 -15.0, 042 -13.9, the action's body -13.3) and no regular beat (onset autocorrelation 0.15 against 0.44-0.52), so no drums.

action.caption: Cinematic desert rock instrumental for a video game trailer, guitar-led with a clear melody. It opens slow, warm and spacious for about twenty-five seconds: a clean, reverb-drenched twangy electric guitar plays a lonely, beautiful melody over soft airy pads and a deep warm bass note, no drums; then a short build-up with rising tremolo guitar and a snare roll; then a big drop into energetic, driving desert rock with punchy rock drums, a thick groovy bass, overdriven guitar riffs and a soaring catchy lead guitar hook, building to a triumphant peak; it ends on a big final chord with a short ring-out. Wide stereo mix with guitars panned left and right, spacious reverb, modern polished production, no vocals
action.negative: vocals, singing, voice, choir, audience applause, crowd noise, live recording, childish, cute, toy piano, music box, drum solo, boomy sub bass, harsh noise, metal growl, electronic dance beat, dubstep, fade out, abrupt cut
action.used: From its drop (the energy's jump at 39.50 s, +27 dB over 6 s) to its ring-out (above -40 dBFS until 68.55 s). Its tempo measured 111.1 BPM.

rounds: Four single-piece renders asking for a ~25 s calm intro (021-024, 72 s) and four asking more strongly (031-034, 66 s): none kept a calm intro longer than ~8 s. A piece calm from start to end (the intro, 32 s) keeps it, so the part with the scenes and the action are two renders in one key and tempo.
